rule: order = the order of the code slides of the deck; the page tab lists the examples by name in this order; each runs as setup + listing, with the library defined in the page

library.import: import sen0401_ch10_lib_v1_0_0 as L, sen0401_ch10_p2p_v1_0_0 as P

setup.code:
# setup: the chapter library of the page (L = chapter 10 library, P = the wire code written independently of Bitcoin Core, R = the recorded run of Bitcoin Core 31.1); the page boots these names
import sen0401_ch10_lib_v1_0_0 as L
import sen0401_ch10_p2p_v1_0_0 as P
R = L.run()
src, seen = L.const, L.has

examples.name: The handshake: version first, verack to accept
examples.code:
e = R['e1_handshake']; v = e['node_version']
seq = [c for t, c, n in e['sequence']]
k = ('user_agent', 'version', 'start_height')
hello = tuple(v[x] for x in k)
hello

examples.name: A message is a 24-byte header and a payload
examples.code:
f = P.frame('verack', b'', 'main')
n = int.from_bytes(f[16:20], 'little')
c = f[4:16].rstrip(b'\0').decode()
parts = (f[:4].hex(), c, n, f[20:].hex())
parts

examples.name: Services: what a node offers
examples.code:
full = R['networkinfo_A']['localservicesnames']
pruned = R['e10_pruned']['services']
gone = [s for s in full if s not in pruned]
gone

examples.name: DNS seeds hand out peer addresses
examples.code:
d = R['e11_dns_seeds']
n = [len(v['ipv4']) for v in d['answers'].values()]
f = 'core_src_kernel_chainparams.cpp'
port = src(f, 'nDefaultPort')
(len(n), min(n), max(n), port)

examples.name: addr against addrv2
examples.code:
a = R['e9_addr']
v2 = a['with_sendaddrv2']['addrv2']
np = 'core_src_net_processing.cpp'
cap = src(np, 'MAX_PCT_ADDR_TO_SEND')
(v2['count'], v2['networks'], v2['addr_len'], cap)

examples.name: Connection types and their limits
examples.code:
t = R['e8_types']
n = 'core_src_net.h'
full = src(n, 'MAX_OUTBOUND_FULL_RELAY_CONNECTIONS')
ro = src(n, 'MAX_BLOCK_RELAY_ONLY_CONNECTIONS')
total = src(n, 'DEFAULT_MAX_PEER_CONNECTIONS')
(full, ro, total)

show.expected: [['addr-fetch', True, True, 'v2'], ['block-relay-only', False, False, 'v1'], ['outbound-full-relay', True, True, 'v2']]

examples.name: Headers first: 80 bytes a block
examples.code:
h = R['e2_headers']
got = [h['first_count'], h['second_count']]
(got, h['header_size'], h['height'])

examples.name: Relay by wtxid and the fee filter
examples.code:
r = R['e5_relay']; k = r['invs']
lo, hi = r['feerate_low'], r['feerate_high']
rates = (round(lo, 1), round(hi, 1))
ff = r['peer_feefilter_sat_per_kvb']
h = k['normal_wtxidrelay'], k['feefilter_5sat']
heard = (len(h[0]), len(h[1]))
(ff, rates, heard)

examples.name: An orphan waits for its parent
examples.code:
o = R['e4_orphan']
early = o['child_in_mempool_after_child']
ask = hex(o['node_asked_for_parent'][0][0])
k = 'parent_in_mempool_after', 'child_in_mempool_after'
late = tuple(o[x] for x in k)
(early, ask, late)

examples.name: Every node has its own memory pool
examples.code:
m = R['e10_mempool_vs_utxo']
b = m['before_block']
pools = (b['F_mempool'], b['G_mempool'])
same = m['utxo_hash_F'] == m['utxo_hash_G']
(pools, same, m['utxo_count_F'])

examples.name: Compact blocks: 332 bytes instead of 3,062
examples.code:

sizes

examples.name: The block-finding race
examples.code:
delays = [1, 5, 10, 30, 60]
rival = L.rival_block_probability

p

examples.name: A parity part rebuilds a lost part
examples.code:
parts = [b'compac', b't bloc', b'k mess', b'age!!!']
par = L.parity_code(parts)
lost = [parts[0], None, parts[2], parts[3]]
got = b''.join(L.rebuild(lost, par))
got

show.expression: [i + 1 for i, x in enumerate(lost) if x is None]

examples.name: A light client checks a Merkle path
examples.code:
s = R['e6_spv']; e = R['e6_bloom_enabled']
ok = s['root_from_path'] == s['header_root']
sizes = (s['proof_bytes'], e['full_block_bytes'])
(s['path_len'], ok, sizes)

examples.name: Double-spend odds fall with each confirmation
examples.code:
q = [0.1, 0.3]
zs = (0, 3, 6)
f = L.double_spend_probability
odds = [[round(f(x, z), 4) for z in zs] for x in q]
odds

examples.code:

(same, r['bits'], r['fixed_bits'], r['bytes'])

examples.name: A block filter rebuilt without Bitcoin Core
examples.code:

examples.name: Transport v1 shows its magic, v2 hides it
